plurality.name: Plurality Grimoire
plurality.question: WHERE do we COORDINATE?
plurality.focus: Collaborative technology, digital democracy, plural publics, Taiwan
plurality.description: Thirty acts teaching how sovereign beings coordinate without collapsing — from Taiwan's proof to philosophy, foundation, collaborative technology, impact, and urgency
plurality.source: Weyl & Tang, 'Plurality: The Future of Collaborative Technology and Democracy' (2024)
plurality.attribution: Original book by Weyl & Tang, CC0 Public Domain. Reconstructed and adapted by privacymage for the agentprivacy universe.

opening.proverb: The singularity is a nightmare of collapse. The Plurality is a practice of overlap.

acts.title: The First Overlap
acts.subtitle: In which Soulbis dreams of collapse, Soulbae dreams of isolation, and the Drake appears as ⿻
acts.proverb: The square that overlaps while remaining itself discovers what lies between.

acts.title: The Widening Gulf
acts.subtitle: In which technology and democracy become enemies
acts.proverb: Technology and democracy were torn apart by those who profited from their separation.

acts.title: A View from Yushan
acts.subtitle: In which Taiwan's collision becomes a mountain, the Sunflower Movement blooms, and the Minister appears
acts.proverb: Where tectonic plates collide, mountains rise. Where pressures meet, Taiwan rose.

acts.title: The Life of a Digital Democracy
acts.subtitle: In which vTaiwan deliberates, Pol.is maps consensus, mask maps save lives, and humor defeats rumor
acts.proverb: Taiwan's digital democracy works because it is practiced constantly.

acts.title: The Glyph That Breathes
acts.subtitle: In which ⿻ is revealed as reality's structure — from quantum to cosmos
acts.proverb: Reality itself is plural — from quantum to cosmos.

acts.title: The Web Beneath the Web
acts.subtitle: In which the internet's architecture reveals a plurality pattern
acts.proverb: The spider does not command the web. The spider creates the conditions from which the web emerges. So too with those who build plural systems.
acts.rpp_proverb: Pull one thread and find it connected to everything. This is not metaphor—this is topology.

acts.title: The Teachers Before the Drake
acts.subtitle: In which Simmel, Dewey, Ostrom, Arendt, Allen, Licklider, and Engelbart clear a path
acts.proverb: The architect studies those who built before them—not to copy, but to understand. So too must builders of ⿻ study those who saw plural before the tools existed to embody it.
acts.rpp_proverb: The wise learn from those who saw clearly before the words existed to name what they saw.

acts.title: The Path Abandoned
acts.subtitle: In which the pioneers' vision was forgotten and must be reclaimed
acts.proverb: The pioneer clears the path; the settler walks it; the forgetter loses it; the rememberer finds it again. Each plays their role. Be the rememberer.
acts.rpp_proverb: The road not taken does not disappear. It waits, overgrown, for those who remember it was there.

acts.title: The Foundation Beneath the Floor
acts.subtitle: In which five pillars of digital freedom are revealed
acts.proverb: The carpenter who neglects the foundation builds a house that will fall. The architect of ⿻ must build the operating system before the applications.
acts.rpp_proverb: The house stands not because of the walls you see, but because of the foundation you don't.

acts.title: The Name You Give Yourself
acts.subtitle: In which self-sovereign identity enables without capturing
acts.proverb: The slave is named by the master. The free person names themselves. Self-sovereign identity is the first freedom.
acts.rpp_proverb: The name given by another is a leash. The name you give yourself is a key.

acts.title: The Guilds That Form Themselves
acts.subtitle: In which association emerges rather than being permitted
acts.proverb: One stick breaks easily. A bundle of sticks is strong. But the bundle must bind itself—bound by another, it is merely fuel.
acts.rpp_proverb: The individual who cannot join is alone. The individual who must join is captive. The individual who chooses to join is free.

acts.title: The Market That Doesn't Devour
acts.subtitle: In which commerce preserves rather than extracts the 7th capital
acts.proverb: The merchant who records every purchase owns more than goods—they own the customer. Private commerce is commerce where the customer owns themselves.
acts.rpp_proverb: The market that knows everything you buy knows everything you are. Privacy in commerce is privacy in life.

acts.title: What Can Be Held Together
acts.subtitle: In which property becomes shared, not just owned or unowned
acts.proverb: The miser owns alone and guards anxiously. The community owns together and grows abundantly. Plural property is neither miserly nor careless—it is appropriate.
acts.rpp_proverb: To own alone is to guard. To own together is to grow. The question is not whether to own, but how.

acts.title: The Door That Opens Both Ways
acts.subtitle: In which access enables all other rights
acts.proverb: A feast behind a locked door is not generosity. A democracy behind a paywall is not democracy. Access is what transforms promise into reality.
acts.rpp_proverb: A right that only the privileged can exercise is a privilege, not a right. Access is what makes rights real.

acts.title: Words Before Words
acts.subtitle: In which post-symbolic communication reaches deeper than language
acts.proverb: The wise teacher does not pour knowledge into the student. The wise teacher creates conditions for understanding. Post-symbolic communication creates conditions—the understanding remains yours.
acts.rpp_proverb: Before language divided us into speaker and listener, there was shared experience. Technology can return us there.

acts.title: The World We Build Together
acts.subtitle: In which immersive shared reality creates presence across distance
acts.proverb: The house built by one is owned by one. The village built by many belongs to many. Shared reality is village, not house—build it as community or not at all.
acts.rpp_proverb: Virtual does not mean false. Shared reality, wherever it exists, is real to those who share it.

acts.title: The Creation That Compounds
acts.subtitle: In which the lone genius myth falls and collaborative creation rises
acts.proverb: The tree does not boast of its own growth—it acknowledges the soil, the rain, the sun. Creation that acknowledges its sources grows taller than creation that pretends to stand alone.
acts.rpp_proverb: The lone genius is a myth. Creation has always been collaboration—the question is whether we acknowledge it.

acts.title: The Hearing at Scale
acts.subtitle: In which Pol.is surfaces hidden consensus and democracy gets ears
acts.proverb: The wise leader does not speak loudest but listens longest. Augmented deliberation gives democracy the ears it needs to hear its own wisdom.
acts.rpp_proverb: Democracy fails not because people don't speak but because no one can hear. Technology can solve the hearing problem.

acts.title: Rules That Learn
acts.subtitle: In which governance becomes adaptive — sunset provisions, experiments, federated authority
acts.proverb: The bamboo survives the storm by bending. The oak breaks by standing rigid. Governance must be bamboo, not oak—strong because it adapts.
acts.rpp_proverb: The rigid rule breaks when the world changes. The learning rule bends and grows. Governance must be living, not fixed.

acts.title: The Weight of Wanting
acts.subtitle: In which quadratic voting reveals intensity and plural mechanisms measure caring
acts.proverb: The scale that weighs a feather and a stone equally is not fair—it is blind. True fairness weighs what matters differently than what does not.
acts.rpp_proverb: Not all preferences are equal—even to those who hold them. Plural voting measures what matters, not just what is preferred.

acts.title: The Market That Remembers
acts.subtitle: In which social markets embed transactions in relationships and the 7th capital compounds
acts.proverb: The field that remembers what was planted grows richer each season. The market that remembers its relationships grows richer each transaction.
acts.rpp_proverb: The market that forgets its transactions forgets its relationships. Commerce embedded in community enriches both.

acts.title: The Circle That Includes
acts.subtitle: In which seven technologies synthesize into infrastructure for plural publics
acts.proverb: The single circle includes or excludes. The many overlapping circles include differently—and in their overlap, they create something none could create alone.
acts.rpp_proverb: The public that excludes is private. The public that includes everyone is empty. The plural public includes differently—each belongs somewhere, no one belongs everywhere.

acts.title: The Forge of Peers
acts.subtitle: In which workplaces are liberated through ownership, augmentation, and digital guilds
acts.proverb: The worker who owns nothing is owned. The worker who owns a share owns their dignity. Build workplaces where workers are owners.
acts.rpp_proverb: The workplace that watches you owns you. The workplace where you own a share is the workplace where you are free.

acts.title: The Body's Secrets
acts.subtitle: In which health data becomes sovereign, federated learning protects, and the blade guards the body
acts.proverb: The body speaks only to the one who inhabits it. Others may listen—with permission. Surveillance listens without asking. Health plurality asks.
acts.rpp_proverb: The body knows itself. The doctor helps interpret. The surveillance system claims to know better than both. Only one of these honors the person within the body.

acts.title: The Signal and the Noise
acts.subtitle: In which media is rebuilt through community funding, bridging curation, and federated networks
acts.proverb: The town crier speaks to everyone. The algorithm speaks to each person differently. Plurality requires shared hearing, not personalized whispering.
acts.rpp_proverb: The news that finds you is the news that serves someone else. The news you find is the news that serves you. Who controls the signal?

acts.title: The Commons That Breathes
acts.subtitle: In which the environment is governed through polycentric coordination and future-representing mechanisms
acts.proverb: The forest does not negotiate with the axe. But humans can negotiate with each other about the forest. Plural coordination is the only path that doesn't end in silence.
acts.rpp_proverb: The air we breathe is shared. The water we drink is shared. The future we create is shared. The commons is not optional—it is what we are.

acts.title: The Mind That Grows
acts.subtitle: In which education becomes gardening — collaboration, diversity, deliberation, AI partnership
acts.proverb: The seed knows how to grow. The gardener creates conditions. The factory forces shape. Education should be gardening, not manufacturing.
acts.rpp_proverb: The mind trained to pass tests learns to pass tests. The mind trained to think learns to think. What we measure is what we grow.

acts.title: The Laws That Enable
acts.subtitle: In which policy gardens for plurality — interoperability, data rights, identity infrastructure
acts.proverb: The gardener cannot force the plant to grow. But the gardener can enrich the soil, provide water, protect from pests. Policy is gardening for society—creating conditions where plurality can flourish.
acts.rpp_proverb: Law can cage or liberate. The laws we write reveal the world we want. Write laws for plurality or plurality will never arrive.

acts.title: The Window That Closes
acts.subtitle: In which the 2-3 year window for privacy-first architecture narrows and urgency demands action
acts.proverb: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now. The worst time is next year—when the ground may be paved.
acts.rpp_proverb: The river can be turned when it is small. Once it has carved its canyon, it flows where it will. We are at the headwaters. Soon we will not be.

acts.title: The Ceremony Completes
acts.subtitle: In which the Drake distributes, the dual agents understand their architecture, and the door opens
acts.proverb: The ceremony that completes is the ceremony that releases. Go forth. Be plural.
acts.rpp_proverb: The beginning asked where to go. The middle showed the path. The end reveals: you were never just learning. You were becoming.

closing.proverb: Sovereignty enables coordination. Coordination strengthens sovereignty. We are ⿻.

full_incantation.proverb: The singularity is a nightmare of collapse. The Plurality is a practice of overlap. Learn to see plural. Learn to be plural. Learn to build plural.

variant_acts_archived.note: Five acts exist in two versions — canonical versions selected by matching Act XXX appendix titles
